purpose: Ten original photobooth signature material backgrounds. No people or reference template assets. Neutral gallery rendering is separate.

assets.name: encore-rose
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: full-bleed original photobooth print material background, vertical 2:3. A sumptuous blush-pink couture flat lay: folded rose silk satin, tactile fine French ivory lace, oversized dusty-rose satin ribbon loops entering from upper corners, small real-looking blush garden roses and champagne pearl strands along outer edges. Romantic boutique photobooth print, sophisticated editorial macro realism, soft directional studio light, convincing silky folds and stitched lace. The middle 65 percent is uninterrupted pale rose satin for photos to be placed later; lavish material detail concentrates along the outer edges and top/bottom. Flat front view, fill canvas, no perspective on the whole print. Rich but disciplined composition, exact blush/cream/champagne palette. No text, letters, logos, people, faces, hands, existing photos, photo placeholders, white rectangles, watermark or Canva assets. Create the material itself, not a mockup of a frame on a desk.

assets.name: encore-riviera
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: original luxury coastal photobooth print background, portrait 2:3. A dreamy Azure Riviera material collage photographed directly from above, pale blue rippled silk mingling with translucent turquoise glass-water caustics, delicate ivory scallop shells, small mother-of-pearl shell fragments and short pearl strands concentrated at the outside corners. Subtle cream textured postcard paper corner layers with fine champagne-gold edge, bright Mediterranean daylight, realistic physical textures, premium seaside invitation art direction. The central 65 percent stays softly aqua and quiet because user photos will be composited later; edge ornaments carry the theme. Entire canvas filled with material, orthographic flat print, no scene outside the print. No writing or typography, people, faces, existing photos, rectangular photo windows, logos or watermark. Original artwork rather than any existing template.
